size: log PIT market cap with plausibility filter 1.0.1 (2010+)
limitations: Characteristic slopes are per-interval cross-sectional OLS on a survivor frame; missing characteristics set to 0 (neutral).
Interval returns are buy-and-hold at decision weights; small differences to the funded ledger (drift, costs) are reported via observed/costs fields.
Fundamental characteristics come from the V10 PIT panel (fiscal calendar from today, XBRL scale errors in market-cap-based value yields).
